definition: trying to answer without really knowing
description: A cosy wooden cabin living room on a snowy night. A young man in a rust-coloured sweater wears a black sleep mask over his eyes and kneels on a white shaggy rug, feeling the face of a big fluffy white dog with both hands and talking, trying to work out what it is, while the dog licks its lips. A young woman in a pink sweater holds the dog and laughs, and another young woman in a green sweater laughs so hard on the sofa that she covers her face. A wood stove burns, with board games and mugs on the table.

en.question: What is the blindfolded man doing?

de.answer: Er streichelt das Gesicht des Hundes.
de.question: Was macht der Mann mit den verbundenen Augen?

es.answer: Está acariciando la cara del perro.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el hombre con los ojos vendados?

fr.answer: Il caresse la tête du chien.
fr.question: Que fait l'homme aux yeux bandés ?
